name: Zen Personal Tweaks
description: Folder persistence, Split View close controls, and Arc-like folder search.

folder-state.uc.js.name: Folder State Persistence
folder-state.uc.js.description: Remember visible folder tabs and restore them after restarting Zen.

split-view-smart-close.uc.js.description: Use native last-tab × to close inactive Split View; no floating overlay or tab shift.

folder-search.uc.js.description: Visible search input for every folder popup; icons and titles without dates.
